Rewording the scene text so it no longer says "cooling fault" fixed it (0 of 12). Apply that rewording to the repository package.

b. scripts/ringer/phase1/act2_guard_probe.py and tests/test_act2_guard_probe.py: the repository package now already contains the new wording, so the `wording` arm's replacements would fail. Rename that arm to `legacy` and make it apply the REVERSE replacements (new text back to the old "cooling fault" text, in knowledge.yaml and plot.md, each exactly once, raising ValueError if the new text is absent). `control` is the unedited repository package; `leakterms` still inserts the two leak_terms lines. Update ARMS, the dry-result expectations in the checker, the CLI choices and the tests accordingly. Expected dry booleans (prompt_has_cooling_fault, leak_map_has_cooling_fault, leak_map_has_restricted_infrastructure_corridors): control (False, True, True); legacy (True, True, True); leakterms (False, False, True). Keep the budget guard, --confirm rule and everything else unchanged.

OUTPUT. Leave changes uncommitted. Run ruff format on every Python file you touch. The harness check exports your final copies of the two guard-probe files separately (they are untracked here) and a patch of everything else. It verifies the three data edits are exactly right, that the package loads and the guard-relevant 2A prompt no longer says "cooling fault", runs the focused propagation suites and the node unit tests, and exports a patch. In your final message list every file changed and every regenerated file.
